title: One Life [NanoVirus]
description: You have only one life (Like in hardcore) but also after your death a corpse is spawn (Last thing that they will have after you)
body:
You have only one life. After your death is game over.

And just a bonus after your death a corpse will be spawn and other players can took your head from this corpse to make you a great memorial.

OR YOUR KILLER WILL TAKE YOUR HEAD AND KEEP IT IS A TROPHY OF HIS ACHIEVEMENT

Have fun!
